about: The listing on the Ocala and Marion County tourism site links to the Ocala Main Street parade page for full details and entry information.

The tourism listing describes the parade as a way to kick off the holiday season and says residents and visitors are invited to line the route. The address given for the Historic Downtown Square is 1 SE Broadway Street.
Marion County also holds the Dunnellon parade on December 5, the Belleview parade on December 6 and the Ocala Christmas Parade on December 12, according to the same tourism site.
faq: When is the Ocala golf cart parade?
Saturday, December 5, 2026. The parade runs 6 to 7 PM, with tailgating and judging starting at 4 PM.
Does it cost anything?
No, the host calls it a free community event.
Where do I watch?
The Downtown Square and Gazebo. The host says to bring a lawn chair.
What happens after the parade?
A tailgating after party starts at 7 PM at Scotty Andrews Duck Pond.

about: Visit Pensacola's listing gives the route as Avenida 10 to the Gulfside Pavilion near Casino Beach. The Pensacola Beach Chamber of Commerce lists a starting spot at Gowens Park on Panferio Drive.
Other sites list the parade as rolling down Via de Luna and give an end time between 3:30 and 4 PM, so arrive early if you want a front spot.
The same weekend, Pensacola's downtown Winterfest runs on Palafox Street with ticketed tours, according to the Winterfest site.
faq: When is the Surfin' Santa Parade?
Sunday, December 6, 2026, starting at 2 PM.
Where does it end?
At the Gulfside Pavilion near Casino Beach.
Who do I call with questions?
The Pensacola Beach Chamber of Commerce lists (850) 932-1500.
Is there a cost?
Visit Pensacola does not list a ticket price for the parade.

about: Holiday on the Bay is the second of two snow nights at The Village Shops on Venetian Bay this season. Local guides say the earlier night, Grand Illuminations, runs the same hours with the same 6 PM snow show.
The shopping center sits at 4200 Gulf Shore Boulevard North in Naples. The host files the event under dining, shop and Village events.
Santa Paws, a pet photo event, is also listed at Third Street South on December 12 and at Mercato on December 17, according to a Naples holiday guide.
faq: When is Holiday on the Bay?
Saturday, December 12, 2026, from 3 PM to 7 PM.
When does it snow?
The host says snow begins to fall at 6 PM around Naples' tallest Christmas tree.
Are Santa photos free?
The host lists complimentary photos with Santa.
Where is it?
The Village Shops on Venetian Bay, 4200 Gulf Shore Blvd N, Naples.
